newsitem.title: UK: Bakyrchik J/V to own Kazakhstan gold mine.
newsitem.headline: Bakyrchik J/V to own Kazakhstan gold mine.

text.p: Bakyrchik Gold Plc said on Monday that it has agreed with the Kazakhstan government to increase its holding in the Bakyrchik mining joint venture to 85 percent from 40 percent.
It said in a statement that Singapore-based Indochina Goldfields Ltd will buy the remaining 15 percent.

Bakyrchik, which is listed on the London stock exchange, said the total consideration for Kazakhstan's 60 percent in the joint venure is $60 million, plus a $5 million bonus, payable in cash in four equal installments over a 16 month period.
Indochina Goldfields has agreed to provide Bakyrchik with a 12 month working capital loan facility of $20 million.
Gordon Toll, chairman of Bakyrchik, said, "The Bakyrchik mine is believed to be the only major gold mine in Central Asia, in which foreign investors have obtained 100 percent ownership."

The Bakyrchik Mining Joint Venture was established to develop and operate the Bakyrchik mine in north east Kazakhstan. Under the original joint venture Bakyrchik was responsible for 100 percent of the funding.
By 0848 GMT, shares in Bakyrchik were 15p higher at 234.
